resources.string: Pick one local video to play
When resolution or frame rate is Auto, follow this device\'s recommended tier. Manual choices are never overwritten.
Shows resolution, FPS, dropped frames, decoder offset, GPU time, and frame time. Default off.

All playback and processing happen on this device. PixelRestore Player does not upload videos, does not use cloud processing, remote inference, or AI APIs, and does not include analytics or tracking. The app does not request Internet access.
Mosaic Reconstruction estimates detail from the pixelation grid and neighboring frames. It is mosaic artifact removal, not recovery of the original pixels. Blur-then-sharpen is not the mosaic path.
Auto estimates the square size and phase from a center crop. If auto misses, pick 2×2 through 32×32.
Low: block bilinear and sharpen. Medium: edge-aware, deblock, temporal match, sharpen. High adds Catmull-Rom on smooth areas and a wider motion search. Medium is the 720p / 30 FPS target.
Shows Original, the detected grid, the reconstruction, or the final image, plus block size and offset.
This app does not use AI or machine-learning models.
